# Major

#### Feature

- Use a record's SEO title for the page title and its SEO description (falling back to the abstract) for the meta description on single views (#107)
- On single views a record's title now takes precedence over the SEO title of the page the plugin is on (#107)
- [BREAKING] `AnthologyController` takes a `MetaDescriptionProvider` as a sixth constructor argument. Subclasses that declare their own constructor must accept it and pass it to `parent::__construct()` (#107)

#### Documentation

- Document how the page title and meta description are generated (#107)
